versions.changelog:
golang-google-wire 1.1.0

- Added support for new harnesses and tooling (Codex, gopls, godig).
- Expanded documentation with pointers to `pkg.go.dev` and related skills for Go package details and code navigation.
- Updated compatibility and metadata, including new `paths` and allowed tools (e.g., Bash(godig:*), Bash(gopls:*), LSP).
- Removed legacy `skill-card.md`, streamlining documentation.
- Improved guidance on how to prefer skills for code analysis and navigation.

golang-google-wire 1.0.3

- Bumped version to 1.0.3 in metadata.
- Added explicit "Dependencies" section for wire installation in documentation.
- Minor wording improvements and clarified formatting in SKILL.md.
- Removed outdated file: skill-card.md.

- Update metadata version to 1.0.2.
- Change install instructions to use go get -tool github.com/google/wire/cmd/wire@latest (was go install).
- Minor wording and formatting tweaks for accuracy and consistency.
- No functional changes to the skill logic.

Initial release: compile-time dependency injection skill for Go using google/wire.

- Explains core google/wire concepts: providers, provider sets, injectors, build tags, explicit interface bindings, struct/value providers, and codegen workflow.
- Includes comparison table (Wire vs. runtime DI containers).
- Covers usage of wire.NewSet, wire.Build, wire.Bind, wire.Struct, wire.Value, wire.InterfaceValue, and wire.FieldsOf.
- Documents best practices for maintaining provider sets, injector files, and generated code.
- Provides usage examples and links to official resources.
- Notes archive status of google/wire (August 2025) and alternatives for runtime DI.
